Q1.e: Stage 1/2/3 answers are intervals; the unique moderate interval is correct in stages 1 and 3 ('약 20~35%'/ '약 40%' vs extremes 90+/5/1/85), and stage 1's wrong 'a' is the textbook base-rate trap, so a student who knows 'the answer is lower than you think' gets 2 of 3 without computing. Stage 1 correct is also the longest option. Real computation is needed to be sure of stages 2-3; the hint (1000 items) makes it feasible.

Q2.e: Keys recomputed: P(불량|양성)=18/67=26.9%; two positives 16.2/18.65=86.9%; ++- 1.62/3.9475=41.0% - all correct. Write s2: w2 requires a digit, so a correct purely conceptual explanation ('불량은 아주 적어서 양성이 나와도 정상품일 가능성이 더 크다 ... 정상 제품이 많거든') fails w2; w1 matches 'wrong' answers: '검사기 정확도 90%니까 양성이면 불량일 확률이 90%야 정상은 훨씬 많아도 상관없어 98개 1000개' passes. The sentence '같은 제품을 여러 번 검사해도 각 검사의 결과는 서로 영향을 주지 않는다고 가정(독립)' reads as unconditional independence, which is false here (results are correlated through the product's true state) and contradicts the updating in stages 2-3; it must say 'given whether the product is defective'.

Q3.e: Level 3 but dense: four probabilities, three stages, vocabulary 양성/음성/독립 in a 5-line paragraph; each stage needs a multi-step natural-frequency computation (stage 3 needs 0.9x0.9x0.1 vs 0.05x0.05x0.95). 15 min is tight if the student computes all three stages.

Q4.e: Every wrong option has a targeted reveal (confusing P(양성|불량) with P(불량|양성); 'testing again is useless'; ignoring the miss rate), 'after' texts show the 1000-item counts, reflect prompt asks for the 27->87->41 path. Hints are actions.

Q5.e: Base-rate neglect and sequential updating transfer to screening, spam filters, etc. Factory (not medical) context is a deliberate choice.

defects: Independence sentence is mathematically imprecise (needs 'conditional on the true status').
suggestedFixes: Reword: '불량인지 정상인지가 정해져 있을 때, 같은 제품의 각 검사 결과는 서로 영향을 주지 않는다고 가정해요.'
Randomise option order / make interval widths comparable so the moderate-option heuristic does not work; add a decoy interval near 40-60 in stage 1 (e.g. 40-55%).
w2: accept 비율|배|많|적 as numeric-free evidence; w1: add a none-check for '상관없'.

Q1.e: s1 is plain sign reading. s2: correct 'b' is the longest (34) and the only 'false' answer whose reason points to the table; hint 2 says 'f'(0)=0인데 극값이 아닌 함수가 있는지 찾아보세요' (= the answer). s3 hint 2 and s4 hint 2 almost dictate the final sentence; s3 is solvable by deriving f'(0)=c and f'=x(3ax+2b).

Q2.e: s4 w1/w2 accept the opposite condition: 'f'(x)의 부호가 x=a의 앞뒤에서 바뀌지 않는다' passes both checks (바뀌 matches 바뀌지) and a long 'no sign change' sentence passes too.
